title: Shaban ka Mahina
body:
Imaan Ka Irfan Ye Irfan Muazzam
Yani Shaoor Deen Hai Shaban Muazzam
Har Saal Kayi Aadmi Jaate Hai Karbala
Har Saal Kayi Bante Hai Insaan Muazzam
Shaban Ka Mahina , Shaban Ka Mahina
Imaan Ka Mahina, Shaban Ka Mahina
Labbaik Ya Hussain Ki(2) Elaan Ka Mahina
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Har Maah Ke Liye Hai Ye Maah E Sarfarazi,
Shabbir Aur Zainab, Aaye Hai Isme Ghazi,
Quran Par Hai Yani(2) Quran Ka Mahina
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ab Mustafa Kahenge Mujhse Hussain Hai Ye,
Aur Mai Hussain Se Hu Ailaan Mera Suniye,
Hai Daste Sayeda Ke(2) Palaan Ka Mahina
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Akbar Ke Noor Ki Ye Tanzeel Ka Mahina,
Hai Noor E Mustafa Ki Tamseel Ka Mahina,
Yani Har Ek Jawan Ki(2) Pehchan Ka Mahina
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Is Maah Sab Hussaini Jannat Mei Jaa Rahe Hai,
Sab Karbala Ke Zaair Naare Laga Rahe Hai,
Ye Hai Yazidiyat Ke(2) Nuksaan Ka Mahina
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Saare Munafiqo Ki Hogi Zabaan Bandi,
Sab Kaazibo Ki Hogi Ab To Bayan Bandi,
Ye Hai Sahi Sahabi(2) Salman Ka Mahina
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jashn E Hussainiat Hai Har Surkhuru Watan Mei,
Sham O Iraq Mei Aur Lebanon Mei Yemen Mei,
Sehoniyat Pe Bhari(2) Iran Ka Mahina
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Daawe Daleel Saare Raddi Mei Daalne Hai,
Bas Al Ajal Mei YASIR lamhe Guzarne Hai,
Hai Barhwein Khudayi(2) Burhan Ka Mahina
Shaban….
Shaban….
Shaban….
